description: For each operation of a flight number on one service date, every position recorded for the aircraft flying it from its departure until its arrival was recorded, oldest first, each with latitude, longitude, barometric altitude, course and whether it is contested (the aircraft was flying for another operation at the same time as far as GADUIN can tell). GADUIN follows the aircraft of some operations only: the others have track null and reason not_tracked. An operation not yet departed, or departed with no position recorded yet, has an empty points list. Positions are what the aircraft's own transponder broadcast, picked up by ground receivers and relayed to GADUIN with a delay, so reported_at_utc, not the time of the request, is when the aircraft was there; where no receiver hears the aircraft (over oceans and remote land) there is no position for that stretch.

date.description: Service date YYYY-MM-DD, as get_flight_status reports it. Operations from the last 30 days and the next 3 are on record.

number.description: Flight number: airline IATA or ICAO code plus number, e.g. AA1.
